He also accused Russia of striking Ukrainian energ
summary: US President Donald Trump claimed that Russia and Ukraine agreed to an immediate 'energy ceasefire'. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky conditionally supported the concept if Russia agreed, but expressed surprise and reported subsequent Russian strikes on power infrastructure in Kyiv and Kharkiv.

title: US President Trump Claims Ukraine-Russia Energy Ceasefire Amid Continued Strikes
description: Image source, Getty ImagesByTinshui YeungPublished11 October 2026Donald Trump has claimed that Russia and Ukraine have agreed to an "energy ceasefire", with Kyiv saying it would support such a move but Moscow yet to comment.The US president insisted that it was "effective immediately" but provided no details.Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky initially expressed surprise at the announcement, before saying Kyiv would support it if Moscow did. He also accused Russia of striking Ukrainian energ
summary: Donald Trump claimed that Ukraine and Russia agreed to an immediate 'energy ceasefire', though the announcement was met with surprise in Kyiv, silence from Moscow, and continued strikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky reported that Russian drone attacks hit a Kyiv power plant and facilities in Kharkiv following the announcement, while cross-border and front-line strikes killed at least eight people in total on Sunday.
